# Feature: GameSetup Zufällig as leading card tile

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-02 — corrected UX: no center hole -->

## Intent
Keep the original Embla character carousel layout. Add one **extra** card-sized „Zufällig“ tile at the **start** of the roster (index 0, default on mount) that runs the existing random spin (no consecutive same). Remove the small toolbar Zufällig button.

## Preconditions
- App open on Play → Gegen Bot → Charakterauswahl (`phase === 'bot'`)
- `BASE_PACK.characters` has ≥1 character

## Happy Path
- [ ] Character slides use Embla carousel as before (center-focus, prev/next)
- [ ] Extra leading slide „Zufällig“ at index 0 (~CharacterSelectCard size, aspect 2/3); Embla `startIndex` shows it first on mount
- [ ] Click (when centered) runs spin / reduced-motion instant pick; `data-testid="game-setup-random-character"`
- [ ] No small toolbar Zufällig next to Spieleinstellungen
- [ ] Manual select + Partie starten unchanged

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Focusing Zufällig slide does not change `selectedId` until spin commits
- [ ] Double-click during spin ignored
- [ ] Single-character list still works with leading Zufällig

## Regression
- [ ] Detail tabs on centered character card still work
- [ ] Spin overlay + no-consecutive-same preserved in GameSetup

## Implementation Notes
- Restored Embla `CharacterCarousel` (no 3-col center hole). Extra leading slide „Zufällig“ (`data-testid="game-setup-random-character"`, aspect 2/3) at index 0 / first pagination dot.
- GameSetup: toolbar Zufällig removed; `onRandom` / spin / no-consecutive-same unchanged.
- Acceptance: verify-ui checkboxes left for `@verify-ui`
